plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-14 from the official Salem College 2026-2027 Undergraduate Catalog (current edition, catoid=34), Design Major (BA) program page (poid=896), Interior Design concentration. Salem College publishes major requirements but no official semester sequence for this program (its Print Degree Planner is a blank worksheet), so the plan is collected in requirements_only form as a single block. The recorded total is the major requirement only; the full degree requirements, including the Salem Impact core (published separately in the same catalog), are not itemized here. Per-course credits are the Hour(s) values printed on each course's own official course detail page in the same catalog; the program page itself prints no per-course credits. No course in this program carries a lab corequisite; the one corequisite in the program (ARTD 380 with ARTD 391, both required here) is disclosed on the ARTD 380 entry. Prerequisites naming courses outside this plan are disclosed in these notes and are not recorded as plan prerequisites. The catalog presents Design as a single major of 11 core courses plus 4 additional required courses within a chosen concentration; it is collected as two plans, one per concentration, following the concentration-plan precedent. The core block is headed 'Required Core courses (34-36 hours)' as printed. Itemized from the detail pages, the fixed core courses and the four OR slots (each counted once) sum to 33, and ARTD 270 Internship in Design is printed at 1-4 Hour(s); recorded at its 1-hour minimum, the core totals 34, the bottom of the stated range (at 4 hours the itemized core would be 37, one above the stated range; the catalog does not explain this, and nothing is corrected). ARTD 380's detail page prints a prerequisite of 'ARTD 375 (pending approval)' and senior standing in the major; ARTD 375 appears nowhere in this program's lists, so it is disclosed here and not recorded. ARTD 391 is titled 'Senior Seminar Interior Design' as printed (no 'in') and is required in the core for all Design majors per its description ('Required of all design majors'), not only for the Interior Design concentration. No residency wording appears on the program page. The Interior Design concentration is headed '(15 hours)' as printed, and its itemized courses sum to exactly 15. The recorded total (49) is core 34 plus concentration 15. Cross-block prerequisite disclosed: ARTD 203 (an option in the first core choice slot) requires ARTD 102 Design, which sits in this concentration and is a required course in this plan. Both concentration choice slots' options (ARTD 202 / ARTD 204 and ARTD 201 / ARTD 205) require ARTD 102, recorded on the slots.

courses.title: Business Practices in Design or Principles of Marketing
courses.choice_note: Select one of ARTD 203 Business Practices in Design or MKTG 230 Principles of Marketing, per the program page's OR structure. Both options are printed at 3 Hour(s). ARTD 203's detail page prints a prerequisite of ARTD 102 (see the plan notes for how that prerequisite sits against each concentration).

courses.title: Digital Design or Visual Representation
courses.choice_note: Select one of ARTD 209 Digital Design or ARTD 180 Visual Representation, per the program page's OR structure. Both options are printed at 4 Hour(s).

courses.title: Internship in Design
courses.choice_note: Printed at 1-4 Hour(s) on its detail page and recorded here at the 1-hour minimum per the standing minimum convention; its description states a prerequisite of junior standing in the major. At 4 hours the itemized core would total 37, above the catalog's stated core range of 34-36 hours; see the plan notes.

courses.title: Advanced Design Studio
courses.choice_note: Its detail page lists a corequisite of ARTD 391 Senior Seminar Interior Design, which is also a required course in this plan; ARTD 391's own detail page lists no corequisite (one-way corequisite as printed). Its printed prerequisite, ARTD 375 (pending approval), names a course that appears nowhere in this program and is disclosed in the plan notes, not recorded.

courses.title: Survey of Western Art I or II
courses.choice_note: Select one of ARTH 121 Survey of Western Art I or ARTH 122 Survey of Western Art II, per the program page's OR structure. Both options are printed at 3 Hour(s).

courses.title: Drawing or Anatomical and Figure Drawing
courses.choice_note: Select one of ARTS 111 Drawing or ARTS 112 Anatomical and Figure Drawing, per the program page's OR structure. Both options are printed at 4 Hour(s). ARTS 112's detail page prints a prerequisite of ARTS 020 or ARTS 111; ARTS 020 is a required course in this plan and is disclosed here rather than recorded on this choice slot.

courses.title: Contract Design or Architectural Details
courses.choice_note: Select one of ARTD 202 Contract Design or ARTD 204 Architectural Details, per the program page's OR structure. Both options are printed at 4 Hour(s) and both print a prerequisite of ARTD 102, recorded on this slot.

courses.title: Residential Interior Design or Computer-Asst. Drafting/Design
courses.choice_note: Select one of ARTD 201 Residential Interior Design or ARTD 205 Computer-Asst. Drafting/Design, per the program page's OR structure. Both options are printed at 4 Hour(s) and both print a prerequisite of ARTD 102, recorded on this slot.
